visibleTestCases.title: Priority-Based Message Routing (Desktop vs Phone vs Watch)
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P1 = spawn(fun() -> ok end), P2 = spawn(fun() -> ok end), P3 = spawn(fun() -> ok end), S0 = [], S1 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session(S0, <<"alice@host/watch">>, -5, P1, #{}), S2 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session(S1, <<"alice@host/phone">>, 5, P2, #{}), S3 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session(S2, <<"alice@host/desktop">>, 10, P3, #{}), {xmpp_presence_router:resolve_message_targets(S3, <<"alice@host">>), xmpp_presence_router:resolve_message_targets(S3, <<"alice@host/phone">>)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Bare JID routes to highest priority (P3 with priority 10); Full JID routes directly to specific resource (P2).

visibleTestCases.title: Pruning Dead Sessions on Process Down
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P1 = spawn(fun() -> ok end), P2 = spawn(fun() -> ok end), S0 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session([], <<"bob@host/web">>, 1, P1, #{}), S1 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session(S0, <<"bob@host/cli">>, 2, P2, #{}), S2 = xmpp_presence_router:remove_session_by_pid(S1, P1), xmpp_presence_router:resolve_message_targets(S2, <<"bob@host/web">>) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: After removing P1, routing to offline web resource falls back to online cli resource.

visibleTestCases.title: Broadcast Presence to Subscribed Contacts
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin PAlice = self(), PBob = spawn(fun() -> receive _ -> ok end end), Roster = #{<<"alice@host">> => [<<"bob@host">>]}, S0 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session([], <<"alice@host/phone">>, 5, PAlice, Roster), S1 = xmpp_presence_router:upsert_session(S0, <<"bob@host/laptop">>, 5, PBob, Roster), xmpp_presence_router:broadcast_presence(S1, Roster, <<"alice@host/phone">>, <<"<presence/>">>) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Delivers presence stanza to Bob (subscribed contact) while skipping sender Alice.
